Technical SEO.title: Google: The Old Position 1-10 Is Hard To Map For Site Owners
Technical SEO.summary: Google's John Mueller stated that the traditional position 1-10 ranking model is hard to map for site owners in the era of Generative AI in Search. He also reiterated how impressions are counted for AI results in Google Search Console, pointing to existing documentation.

Technical SEO.title: Google Ranking Factors Survey: Content and Backlinks Most Important
Technical SEO.summary: A 2026 Google ranking factors survey by Cyrus Shepard and Dawn Shepard, published at Zyppy, finds that content relevance, backlinks, and content quality are ranked as the most important factors by surveyed SEO experts. This is the first such survey in some time.

Technical SEO.title: Google Maps Phone Number in Photo Scam
Technical SEO.summary: Scammers are exploiting the Google Maps contributor program by uploading AI-generated photos containing fraudulent phone numbers across hundreds of Business Profile listings. Reporting these violations to Google has reportedly produced no resolution.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google DeepMind Develops New AI Search Ranking Model
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google DeepMind researchers are testing a unified model called Autoregressive Ranking that is designed to replace current retrieval and ranking methods in search. This is a significant potential shift in how Google's core ranking infrastructure operates.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: New AI Search and SEO KPIs: 4 Signals That Guide Real Decisions
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: LightSite AI's Stas Levitan outlines four first-party signals that marketers can use to connect AI bot attention with human traffic, aiming to support better SEO decision-making. The piece addresses the growing need for new measurement frameworks as AI search expands.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: How Local Businesses Can Build Visibility In AI Search
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Moz leaders Jonathan Berthold and Kevin Chen explain how listings, reviews, mentions, and social activity influence local brand recommendations within AI search results. The piece is directly applicable to multi-location or travel-sector brands optimizing for AI-driven discovery.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Le Monde Says AI Overviews Haven't Hurt Its Audience So Far
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Le Monde reports its audience has not declined since AI Overviews launched in France, with app traffic growth and subscriber gains complicating the broader narrative about AI search harming publisher traffic. This offers a counterpoint data point for enterprise publishers tracking AI Overview impact.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Everyone Is Quoting The Same Number And Getting Different Answers
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Publishers blocking AI crawlers are relying on a shared metric whose denominator omits an unknown share of referrals, making the underlying data unreliable for strategy decisions. This raises important questions about how enterprise SEO teams should evaluate AI crawler blocking policies.

AI Search / GEO.title: How Freshpet Earned AI's Trust: A GEO and AI Visibility Playbook
AI Search / GEO.summary: Freshpet and Intero Digital detail a practical process for auditing AI visibility, restructuring content to earn citations in AI answers, and linking GEO work to measurable business priorities. This is one of the more concrete brand-level GEO case studies available.

AI Search / GEO.title: Apple: 2.5 Billion Siri Requests Every Day
AI Search / GEO.summary: Apple's VP of AI Product Management Lilian Rincon revealed at the September 9, 2026 Apple Event that Siri processes 2.5 billion requests daily. This scale underscores the significance of optimizing for voice and AI assistant surfaces beyond Google.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media Studios published a study analyzing 13,184 citations drawn from four AI tools, examining which sources are referenced in AI-generated answers. This type of citation-pattern data is directly actionable for teams building GEO content strategies.

AI Search / GEO.title: Generative Engine Optimization Goes Mainstream: The 2026 AI-Visibility Landscape
AI Search / GEO.summary: A MarTech Series report covers how Generative Engine Optimization has moved from an emerging tactic to a mainstream discipline in the 2026 AI-visibility landscape. The piece provides context on how brands are adapting their content and authority strategies for AI answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: LLM Pulse presents data on which domains receive the most citations across major AI platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI. Understanding citation distribution across platforms is foundational for enterprise GEO benchmarking.
